The Yootech charger comes with a USB-A to micro USB cable that's engineered to work with the Qualcomm Quick Charge (QC) standards.
Using this Yootech charger and a quality QC compliant power adapter, I can't get it to fast charge with several of my legacy cables.
Bottom line is you'll need to use this cable or another one that meets the QC standard if you intend to wirelessly fast charge an iPhone or any of the 10W Android phones that the seller lists.
An adapter is NOT supplied with the Yootech charger.
To support fast charging rates listed, you'll need a QC 2.0/3.0 power adapter rated at 15W or higher.

An iPhone, out of its protective case, does allow this charger to begin charging and sometimes it continues to charge to 100%.
However, more than half the time, the Yootech stops charging before the iPhone has a full charge.
I am now certain this charger, at least the one I received is defective.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND this Yootech wireless Qi-Certified charger.
